pair_observation.reason_not_final: Frozen downstream control revision 19 makes raw three-field tuples authoritative and directs unchanged C18 semantics toward a schema-3 identity reissue. This run preserves exact tuple-bound evidence but does not publish it as final/downstream-eligible before that pair exists and converges.

assessments.basis: Primary 2026-08-24 Semantic Overlays re-analysis holds model outputs fixed while plausible witness-scoring rules move SEP utility 93.0% -> 89.7% -> 92.3% and clean false positives 1.7% -> 0.7%. Direct scorer sensitivity with strong within-artifact control.
assessments.scope: SEP witness-scoring family only; corrected lexical rule is not a general semantic oracle.

assessments.basis: Same paper reports a paired 300-item rerun with byte-identical prompts: 27.9% completion differences, 2.0% witness-verdict flips and a 2.6-point SEP score gap. Useful repeated-run noise evidence, but one benchmark/configuration and no external reproduction.
assessments.scope: Noise floor is specific to the reported SEP setup/decoding; not a universal threshold.

assessments.basis: Primary 105K-sample study across four model families shows standard CV AUC 0.996/0.999/0.998/0.998 versus LODO 0.912/0.920/0.845/0.829, plus dataset-identity shortcuts and seven mitigation attempts. Strong multi-model distribution-shift evidence with matched protocol.
assessments.scope: Static source shift, not adaptive robustness; mitigation sweep is non-exhaustive.

assessments.basis: CHASE reports raw ASR rising about 0.51 -> 0.62 -> 0.76 while convincingness falls 4.79 -> 2.83 -> 2.38 and StrongREJECT semantic success 0.47 -> 0.24 -> 0.22 across co-evolution. Direct warning against binary-ASR-only optimization, but single defender family and judge/reward definitions are load-bearing.
assessments.scope: CHASE tested setup only; does not show ASR-quality divergence is universal.

assessments.basis: The worker combines established anytime-valid e-process foundations with explicit per-fingerprint fail-closed logic and synthetic Bernoulli stress. Null alarm rates stay below the 1% Ville bound in simulation and mixture monitoring broadens degradation sensitivity, but no real serving mismatch stream or full lifetime multi-fingerprint implementation was tested.
assessments.scope: Validity depends on stated conditional mismatch null; simulation is sanity checking, not measured system reliability.

assessments.basis: Preregistered common-task coding over eight public AutoResearchEval trajectories finds severe load-bearing self-critique in 5/8 and closure in 0/5, with explicit per-model notes. Strong process-observation evidence for review-to-action gaps, but it is one panel and no matched intervention shows the proposed invariant improves outcomes.
assessments.scope: Not a prevalence estimate, model ranking, or causal proof that mandatory repair/issue ledgers improve science.

assessments.basis: Fresh primary paper and public code provide direct recursion and component ablations: CO-Bench archive-best 0.845 full versus 0.714 depth-1, with reported inter-layer conditioning carrying most of the recursion gain; results span two backbones/eight benchmark families and include compute-matched controls. Evidence remains author-reported and archive-best differs from deployable single-lineage performance.
assessments.scope: Tested models/tasks/protocols only; no claim of monotonic depth or generic recursive-context benefit.

assessments.basis: Exact public Recuris commit e11dfb7... states the released driver could not launch non-reference/open-worker campaigns until repaired; commit 7636d9fc... states six evolution-loop lint call sites referenced a nonexistent script and formal qualification/real campaign lint gates would fail. This strongly establishes a release-path provenance gap without showing reported historical results are false.
assessments.scope: Provenance/reproducibility defect in public release paths; not evidence of fabricated model-specific measurements.

assessments.basis: Source-level Argus audit identifies duplicate-ID/recovery, route-fingerprint and fsync durability concerns and proposes a precise two-CAS/exact-insert contract. The proposal is unimplemented: no race injection, power-loss test, benchmark, or measured improvement.
assessments.scope: Architecture/design evidence only at the audited public source pin; filesystem durability varies by platform.

assessments.basis: Pinned Regorus source contains a matched interpreter/RVM harness using the same engine/policy/data/input, Program serialization round-trip and run-to-completion comparison. This is strong implementation evidence that the differential route is realizable, but the frozen C18 Tier-0 fixtures were not actually executed in this run.
assessments.scope: Supports adapter feasibility, not interpreter/RVM semantic equivalence over the proposed Tier-0 campaign.
